title.purpose: Card titles and the product-name header at the top of a workspace. Unchanged from the prior system.

body.purpose: Default text for labels, buttons, list items, and form fields. Unchanged.

label.purpose: Code-like content: PHP output, file paths, log lines, command names. Unchanged.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.value: 0 10px 28px -8px oklch(0.05 0.03 296 / 0.55), 0 2px 10px -3px oklch(0.05 0.03 296 / 0.4) [dark]; lighter/less opaque in light mode
shadows.purpose: Cards, popovers, select dropdowns — the system's new real depth cue, replacing the old ring-only flat model.

shadows.name: ambient-lg
shadows.purpose: Reserved for a future large floating surface; not yet consumed by an existing component.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.value: ring-1 ring-foreground/10 only, no shadow, over bg-black/10 backdrop blur
shadows.purpose: Dialog / Alert Dialog — depth from the dimmed backdrop, the one elevation treatment carried over unchanged from the prior system.

motion.name: overlay-transition
motion.purpose: Unchanged — fast, near-instant open/close for popovers, dialogs, and dropdowns.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.value: animate-pulse on the running-state status dot
motion.purpose: The only new motion — signals a run in progress via Tailwind's default pulse, matching Ray's own live-log feel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button — vivid Ray Orange, dark-violet text (crisper than white at this lightness/chroma).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; background: oklch(0.72 0.19 42); color: oklch(0.16 0.032 296); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.19 42 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat-ground panel with a real offset-blur shadow (The Real Depth Rule) instead of the old ring-only treatment.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 22.4px; background: oklch(0.21 0.04 296); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -8px oklch(0.05 0.03 296 / 0.55), 0 2px 10px -3px oklch(0.05 0.03 296 / 0.4); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; color: oklch(0.96 0.012 296); } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: oklch(0.7 0.035 296); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: New signature component — idle/running/success/error indicator next to the Run button, a direct borrow from Ray's own dot-per-log-entry motif. Reflects existing run state; introduces no new behavior.
components.css: .ds-status-dot { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status-dot.idle { background: oklch(0.7 0.035 296 / 0.4); } .ds-status-dot.running { background: oklch(0.72 0.19 42); animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-status-dot.success { background: #10b981; } .ds-status-dot.error { background: oklch(0.66 0.22 21); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

components.name: Modal (Dialog / Alert Dialog)
components.description: Ring-only, no shadow — the one elevation treatment kept unchanged from the prior system, since the dimmed backdrop already carries depth.
components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-modal { width: 100%; max-width: 384px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 22.4px; background: oklch(0.21 0.04 296); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-modal-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.96 0.012 296); }

narrative.overview:
Pinned by explicit user reference to Ray (myray.app), Spatie's Laravel debug-output desktop app — the closest possible analog to this app's own dd()/dump() output. Verified against Ray's live site and its real in-app dump feed before writing a single token. Replaces "The Bare Terminal" in full.

The world: a deep violet ground carries the whole interface, with one vivid orange accent doing every job color does — primary actions, focus rings, the active nav icon, the run-status dot. Cards and floating surfaces get a genuine offset-blur shadow instead of the old flat ring. Geist Variable stays as the UI typeface — Ray's real face is a commercial font with no legal self-hostable source here, so this is the closest obtainable face, not a drift.
keyCharacteristics: Violet is the new neutral: page, card, and popover form a three-tier ground, all one hue family, never pure gray.
Orange is the single accent — primary actions, focus, and the one live thing per screen, never decoration.
Real shadows (offset + blur, violet-tinted) on cards/popovers/dropdowns; modals stay ring-only.
A colored status dot (idle/running/success/error) — a direct borrow from Ray's own dot-per-log-entry motif.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange means exactly one thing: this is the live, actionable thing on this screen. It never doubles as a status color, a link color, or decoration.

rules.name: The Real Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface in normal page flow that needs to read as above its neighbors gets a real offset-blur shadow now, not a ring pretending to be one. A modal still doesn't need one — its backdrop already does that job.

dos: Do spend orange only on the one live/primary/actionable thing per screen.
Do give any new in-flow surface a real offset-blur shadow from --shadow-ambient, not a flat ring.
Do keep modals ring-only — their backdrop is already their depth cue.
Do use the softer 16px-base radius scale for new surfaces.
Do switch to the monospace stack for code-like content and keep everything else in Geist Variable.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color — orange's whole job depends on there being exactly one.
Don't give a modal a shadow; that's the one surface this world deliberately keeps flat.
Don't render Artisan (or any command-output) stdout as HTML.
Don't reach for pure black/white/gray anywhere — every neutral carries the violet hue.
Don't design for phone/tablet breakpoints — this is a native desktop window.
